cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You apologised for missing my concert. What do you think the empty seat felt like? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know the timetable. I'm asking about the seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You felt let down. I watched the recording this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you saw me look at the door before the encore. Can you understand how it felt to keep expecting you?

mechanism: A directs a conversation about concert hurt but yields the order and method of explanation to keep B willing to acknowledge the emotional cost.
confusable: Unlike seeking compensation or factual blame, A needs recognition of waiting and humiliation; borrowed authority keeps revising the way B can say it.
comparison: A missed concert with shared recording differs from six weeks of silence and an explanation difficult to phrase.
seedUse: Use D75-a train/empty seat/recording and S02-a managing a flexible conversation order.
